details.title: Squeezebox Radio and Touch Spotify Connect Repository

applet.name: SpotifyConnect
applet.title: Spotify Connect
applet.desc: Standalone Spotify Connect playback for Logitech Squeezebox Radio. LMS is only needed to install the applet.
applet.changes: Preserve complete track endings with immediate manual skips; fix mobile song selection and native Now Playing updates; eliminate shell polling from the UI.
applet.creator: Sjoerd Brandsma
